query:
UPDATE gallery_items SET 
  description = 'Commercial shot blasting of structural steel columns at a large industrial facility. The blasting removes decades of paint, rust and mill scale to achieve a Sa 2.5 near-white metal standard.',
  detailedDescription = 'This project involved the complete removal of multiple layers of old industrial paint and heavy rust from structural steel columns throughout a large commercial facility undergoing full refurbishment. Using iron silicate (copper slag) as the blasting media, our team achieved a consistent Sa 2.5 near-white metal cleanliness grade across every column, with a sharp Rz 50–75 μm anchor profile ideal for the replacement coating system. The before image shows the heavily coated and corroded column surface; the after image shows the clean, profiled bare metal ready for the coating contractor.'
WHERE id = 60001;

UPDATE gallery_items SET 
  description = 'Shot blasting of concrete floors and steel columns within a large commercial warehouse during a major refurbishment project.',
  detailedDescription = 'A comprehensive surface preparation project covering both the structural steel columns and concrete floor areas within a large commercial warehouse. The steel columns required full coating and rust removal to Sa 2.5 standard using iron silicate media, while the concrete floor areas were prepared to receive a new industrial floor coating system. Our mobile blasting equipment allowed us to work efficiently across the entire building footprint, treating both surface types in a single mobilisation. The project was completed with minimal disruption to the ongoing refurbishment programme.'
WHERE id = 60002;

UPDATE gallery_items SET 
  description = 'Wide-area shot blasting of structural steelwork in a large commercial building. The project involved cleaning and preparing dozens of columns across the full building footprint.',
  detailedDescription = 'One of our largest single-site structural steel projects, this commercial building required shot blasting of every structural column across a vast open-plan floor area. The scale of the project demanded careful planning and sequencing to maintain programme efficiency while keeping the site safe for other trades working in adjacent bays. Iron silicate media was used throughout to deliver consistent Sa 2.5 cleanliness and the anchor profile required by the protective coating specification. The wide-angle before and after images illustrate the dramatic transformation achieved across the full extent of the steelwork.'
WHERE id = 60003;

UPDATE gallery_items SET 
  description = 'Close-up detail of a structural steel column mid-blast, showing the transition between coated and freshly blasted bare metal.',
  detailedDescription = 'This close-detail image captures the precise moment of transformation during active shot blasting — the boundary between the original coated surface and the freshly blasted bare metal is clearly visible. The image demonstrates the quality of the Sa 2.5 near-white metal finish achieved using iron silicate media: a clean, bright surface with the angular anchor profile required for long-term coating adhesion. This type of close-up quality check was carried out on every column throughout the project to confirm the specified cleanliness grade before the blasting team moved on.'
WHERE id = 60004;

UPDATE gallery_items SET 
  description = 'On-site shot blasting of structural steel columns and beams in a commercial building undergoing full refurbishment. The project involved systematic treatment of all steelwork across multiple bays.',
  detailedDescription = 'A systematic structural steelwork refurbishment project covering multiple bays of a large commercial building. Our team worked methodically through the building, treating each column and beam in sequence to ensure no areas were missed and the coating contractor could follow directly behind. Iron silicate media delivered the Sa 2.5 near-white metal standard specified for the new intumescent and protective coating system. The project was completed on programme, with all blast media recovered and the site left clean and ready for the next trade. The before and after images show the full-width view of the steelwork transformation across the building.'
WHERE id = 60005;
